prompt:
Hey — we're about to kick off the Q3 serum launch and our team's notes are completely scattered across Slack exports, emails, a product brief, creator roster, budget thread, and legal checklist. No one has a single clear picture of what we're doing.

Can you pull all of that together from the files in the workspace/campaign_q3 and workspace/ops folders and produce a single normalized brief that our whole team — and any downstream tools — can immediately use?

Save it as creator_commerce_context_pack.md.

The brief needs to be genuinely useful, not just a wall of text. Our team will be handing it to whoever writes the creator scripts and designs the offers next, so it needs to be complete, structured, and honest about what we know versus what we're still guessing at.
